title: Joovy Recalls Zoom 360 Ultralight Jogging Strollers Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The stroller's front wheel bearing can fail or detach, posing a fall and injury hazard. Units: About 9,200.

title: ElliptiGO Recalls Arc Model Stand-Up Bicycles Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The bicycle frame can break while riding, posing fall and injury hazards to the user. Units: About 3,800 (In addition, about 31 were sold in Canada).

title: Hobby Lobby Recalls White Wood Stools Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The stools can break during use, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: About 14,000.

title: Walmart Recalls Better Homes and Gardens Essential Oil Infused Aromatherapy Room Spray with Gemstones Due to Rare and Dangerous Bacteria; Two Deaths Investigated
summary: Tests conducted by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) determined that a bottle of the room spray contained the rare and dangerous bacteria Burkholderia pseudomallei which causes melioidosis, a condition that is difficult to diagnose and can be fatal. Units: About 3,900.

title: KTM North America Recalls Off-Road Motorcycles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The retaining "R" clips on the front brake caliper pin can fall out, causing the front brakes to fail, posing a crash hazard to the rider. Units: About 1,840 (In addition, 265 in Canada).

title: Lightform Recalls LED Projectors Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The projector's fan can malfunction and overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,600.

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Tarmac SL7 Bicycles and Framesets Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The bicycle's fork steerer tube can crack or break after harsh impact such as hitting a deep pothole or other stress event, posing fall and injury hazards to riders. Units: About 6,900.

title: Design Within Reach Recalls Arc Collection Furniture Due to Violation of the Federal Lead Paint Ban (Recall Alert)
summary: Surface paint on the furniture contain levels of lead that exceed the federal lead paint ban, posing a risk of lead poisoning. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 200.

title: 5.11 Recalls Tactec Plate Carriers Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The cable in the quick release system of the plate carrier can separate from the handle preventing swift removal of the carrier in an emergency situation, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 45,170.

title: Liberty Hardware Recalls Glass Cabinet Knobs Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The glass stem of the knobs can break during use, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 38,000.

title: Magnussen Home Recalls Nova Series 5-Drawer Chests Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards
summary: The recalled chests are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in death or serious injuries to children. title: Meridian Furniture Recalls Ottomans Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The metal band at the base can contain sharp edges, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 7,800.

title: myCharge Recalls Powerbanks Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The powerbank's lithium-ion battery can overheat and ignite, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: 67000.
